changelog: Publish the reviewed Zhongcao OOTD Lookbook Maker workflow with its English ClawHub listing.
summary: Create a coordinated REDnote (Xiaohongshu) OOTD lookbook from outfit photos or a styling idea. Build a vertical 3:4 fashion carousel with a cover, full-look outfit image, styling-detail image, and lifestyle scene, then shape a ready-to-publish fashion recommendation post with title ideas, caption angles, and tags. Use this AI outfit image maker for Xiaohongshu outfit posts, OOTD photos, fashion lookbooks, clothing recommendation visuals, creator style diaries, and brand collaboration campaigns. Optionally it reads Xiaohongshu itself — the notes already running for the topic, one page of a note's top comments, and an account's own recent notes — so Xiaohongshu research, competitor note analysis and comment analysis rest on the platform instead of on guesswork.
